guide.title:
Your dedicated concierge
for The Grand Ho Tram resort
guide.body: About two hours by road from Ho Chi Minh City, The Grand Ho Tram resort complex sits on the Ho Tram coast. From the rooms and facilities of its three hotels to The Bluffs golf course and transfers, we guide first-time visitors step by step to choices that fit their schedule and party.
guide.hotelsBody: Compare rooms and facilities across the three hotels and get advice on the right room for your trip.
guide.golfBody: We help you plan rounds at The Bluffs links course together with your stay.
guide.transferBody: From airport pickup to resort transfers, we arrange a vehicle to fit your schedule.
